metadata.question: Did the Sonoran Desert experience land surface temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius in 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use RESOLVE Ecoregions (RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017) to get "Sonoran Desert" geometry. Time range: 2019-01-01 to 2019-12-31. Collections: MODIS LST Day 1km (MODIS/006/MOD11A1 and MYD11A1). If either collection is empty, try version 061 as fallback. 
2. Masking strategy: Use QC_Day bits 0–1 < 2 (retain "good" and "other quality") and mask non-positive LST. Convert to Kelvin with scale 0.02. 
3. Logic: Compute per-pixel annual maximum LST over 2019, then regional maximum via reduceRegion. Validate: if no images → C1; if 0 valid pixels after masking → C2; if max is null/NaN or outside 200–450 K → C3. Threshold: 348.15 K (75°C). If regional max > threshold → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2019-01-01';
    const end = '2019-12-31';

    // Get Sonoran Desert geometry from RESOLVE ecoregions
    const ecoFC = ee.FeatureCollection('RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017');
    let eco = ecoFC.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ECO_NAME', 'Sonoran Desert'));
    let ecoSize = await eco.size().getInfo();
    if (ecoSize === 0) {
      eco = ecoFC.filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('ECO_NAME', 'Sonoran'));
      ecoSize = await eco.size().getInfo();
    }
    let geom;
    let regionSource = '';
    if (ecoSize > 0) {
      geom = ee.Feature(eco.first()).geometry();
      regionSource = `RESOLVE (features: ${ecoSize})`;
    } else {
      // Fallback coarse polygon covering Sonoran Desert extent
      geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
        [-116.5, 34.8],
        [-108.0, 34.8],
        [-108.0, 27.0],
        [-116.5, 27.0],
        [-116.5, 34.8]
      ], null, false);
      regionSource = 'Fallback polygon';
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check

    // Prep function for MODIS LST (Day)
    function prepLST(img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // keep bits 0-1 < 2 (good or other quality)
      const lstK = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
                      .updateMask(mask)
                      .updateMask(img.select('LST_Day_1km').gt(0))
                      .multiply(0.02)
                      .rename('LST_K');
      return lstK.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    }

    function getModisCols(versionPrefix) {
      const modCol = ee.ImageCollection(`${versionPrefix}/MOD11A1`)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .map(prepLST);
      const mydCol = ee.ImageCollection(`${versionPrefix}/MYD11A1`)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .map(prepLST);
      return {modCol, mydCol};
    }

    // Try V006 first
    let {modCol, mydCol} = getModisCols('MODIS/006');
    let modCount = await modCol.size().getInfo();
    let mydCount = await mydCol.size().getInfo();

    // If empty, try V061
    if ((modCount + mydCount) === 0) {
      ({modCol, mydCol} = getModisCols('MODIS/061'));
      modCount = await modCol.size().getInfo();
      mydCount = await mydCol.size().getInfo();
      if ((modCount + mydCount) === 0) {
        console.log(`Region source: ${regionSource}`);
        console.log(`MOD11A1 2019 Images: 0`);
        console.log(`MYD11A1 2019 Images: 0`);
        console.log('Combined Images: 0');
        console.log('No data for 2019 in the region.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    const all = modCol.merge(mydCol);
    const allCount = await all.size().getInfo();

    // 3. Processing: annual max and valid pixel count
    const maxImg = all.max(); // per-pixel annual max LST
    // Valid pixels count (non-masked)
    const countDict = await maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const validCount = countDict ? (countDict['LST_K'] || 0) : 0;

    const totalDict = await ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const totalCount = totalDict ? (totalDict['const'] || 0) : 0;
    const validPct = (totalCount > 0) ? (100.0 * validCount / totalCount) : 0;

    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Region source: ${regionSource}`);
      console.log(`MOD11A1 2019 Images: ${modCount}`);
      console.log(`MYD11A1 2019 Images: ${mydCount}`);
      console.log(`Combined Images: ${allCount}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount} / ${totalCount} (${validPct.toFixed(2)}%)`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after QC/masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: regional maximum LST
    const maxDict = await maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const maxK = maxDict ? maxDict['LST_K'] : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (maxK === null || isNaN(maxK) || maxK < 200 || maxK > 450);
    const thresholdK = 348.15;
    const maxC = (maxK !== null && !isNaN(maxK)) ? (maxK - 273.15) : null;

    console.log(`Region source: ${regionSource}`);
    console.log(`MOD11A1 2019 Images: ${modCount}`);
    console.log(`MYD11A1 2019 Images: ${mydCount}`);
    console.log(`Combined Images: ${allCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels (annual max): ${validCount} / ${totalCount} (${validPct.toFixed(2)}%)`);
    if (invalid) {
      console.log(`Max LST: invalid`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    } else {
      console.log(`Max LST: ${maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${maxC.toFixed(2)} °C)`);
      console.log(`Threshold: 348.15 K (75 °C)`);
      const answer = (maxK > thresholdK) ? 'A' : 'B';
      console.log(answer);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
